verdict.rationale: Pendo documents an official MCP server that gives AI workflows instant access to usage data, visitor behavior, and customer context. It is listed in Claude's Connectors Directory, and Leo brings natural-language product intelligence into Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor, so an agent can answer product and growth questions from live Pendo data. Missing for 10: documentation of the specific MCP tools or query capabilities (e.g., funnels, retention, segment queries), a documented query API or OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
